explanation: The theorem is about library-specific objects (wreathO F W.D, swapConjHom F, F.sO, the orthogonal group of a frame). It says that the conjugation by the swap element s preserves wreathO ⊓ G, where G contains the commutator subgroup (so is normal) and s lies in wreathO. The proof combines normality of G, s ∈ wreathO (so s normalizes it), and Subgroup.map_inf for an injective hom. The Mathlib ingredients (Subgroup.Normal.map_conj_eq, Subgroup.map_inf, Subgroup.mem_normalizer_iff_map_conj_eq, Subgroup.Normal.of_commutator_le) are general facts and need several steps and auxiliary facts. No single Mathlib declaration states this result, and I did not search for one beyond these.
